BS AI Student & Flutter Developer building real-world mobile systems

I'm Ali Hassan, a BS Artificial Intelligence student at The Islamia University of Bahawalpur (IUB) and a passionate Flutter developer. I specialize in building complete, production-style mobile applications with clean UI, powerful Firebase backends and real-world features.

From a full Food Delivery Ecosystem (Customer, Admin & Rider apps) to real-time chat, e-commerce and document-management apps — I love taking an idea all the way to a working, polished product with real-time data, payments, maps and role-based workflows.

Project 01

Food Delivery Ecosystem

FlutterDartFirebaseFirestoreMapsReal-Time Tracking

A complete food delivery ecosystem consisting of Customer, Admin and Rider applications — all connected through a shared Firebase backend.

  • User authentication, profiles & address management
  • Food browsing, cart, checkout, coupons & multiple payment methods
  • Live order tracking & delivery location tracking on maps
  • Admin order workflow, rider assignment & payment verification
  • Customer–rider chat, support & real-time delivery status
Multi-role real-world delivery system connecting customers, administrators and riders through a shared Firebase backend.
